cars.specification_market: Original supercharged GTLM road convertible described by Mark Vaughn in AutoWeek article labelled 2005 model and published 22 January 2006. Eleven attributes retain that firsthand report, including nominal 4.6-litre SVT V8, Eaton supercharger, reported output/torque peaks, limited-slip differential, steering and GTLM rear module. No exact cc, output standard, boost, valvetrain, gearbox count, dimensions, brake geometry or timed speed inferred. Steering ratio is report-scoped, not independently measured here; published curb weight is not imported. Later manufacturer 6.2-litre Esperante Classic specification is not transferred. Related GTLM race car Le Mans class win provides programme history only, not road-car achievement or race engine/chassis specification. Group original road Esperante/GT/GTLM bodies, engines and later related road development conservatively once; no GTS, GTLM racer, GTR-1, LMP, prototype or extra upgrade/body count. Existing AIV Roadster is a different earlier model despite sharing steering hardware. Generic soft-top Esperante photo matches family/body only and is not authenticated as GTLM, drive car, engine or original equipment.
